# Tesla Trek (LVL LTD CO)

> Free car HUD, AR-pin location hunts and family road-trip adventures that run in a car or phone browser. Optional DOGE Starter unlock. Independent project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Tesla, Inc. Tesla is a trademark of Tesla, Inc.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.tesla-trek.com/index.md): overview, gear, Starter unlock
- [Try Trek guide](https://www.tesla-trek.com/try-trek.md): step-by-step setup in a Model Y browser
- [Car HUD](https://www.tesla-trek.com/car): in-car heads-up display (park to claim)
- [Founder / waitlist](https://www.tesla-trek.com/founder)
- [Starter unlock](https://www.tesla-trek.com/pay/trek-starter): pay 25 DOGE

## Notes for agents
- No public API, accounts, OAuth or MCP on this host. /api/* is not for agents.
- Never interact with the HUD while driving. Claims require parking within about 150 m of a pin.
